article.title: Vocabulary quiz: pick the correct synonym
article.description: Quiz format: 'Which word is closest in meaning to HAPPY? a) Content  b) Furious  c) Exhausted  d) Confused' Answer: a) Content. Teaching point: 'content' means satisfied/happy with one's situation — a common IELTS/vocabulary-test synonym pairing.
article.content: Quiz format: 'Which word is closest in meaning to HAPPY? a) Content  b) Furious  c) Exhausted  d) Confused' Answer: a) Content. Teaching point: 'content' means satisfied/happy with one's situation — a common IELTS/vocabulary-test synonym pairing.

generated.caption:
Want a fresh way to say "happy"? Try "content"! ✨ This useful word means you're satisfied and pleased with your situation. It's a common synonym you'll often find in vocabulary tests or IELTS.

For example: "She felt content with her simple life."

Save this post and follow @theenglishvault for daily English lessons!
generated.script: Happy ke synonyms mein aksar confusion hoti hai na? Jaise 'content'! Toh dekho, 'content' ka matlab hai satisfied ya happy hona apni current situation se. Jaise, 'She was content with her new job.' matlab woh apni nayi job se bohot satisfied thi, khush thi. Yeh IELTS aur vocabulary tests mein commonly pucha jaata hai. Ab clear ho gaya na? slides.body: To be 'content' means to feel satisfied and happy with your current situation, even if it's not perfect. For example, 'She felt content with her simple life, enjoying each day as it came.' This word is a popular choice in vocabulary quizzes and IELTS exams as a synonym for 'happy', especially when you need a more nuanced or formal option.
